### `patches/21.PORT.FIXES.158/028-d-157-00-uitour-has-no-smart-window-lazy-aiwindow-was-undeclared.patch`

- **PROVEN** C-0366 (line 2): "D-157-00: UITour's showFirefoxAccountsForAIWindow is inert. Every number above is recomputed from the tree, the installed build and the claims register; nothing is carried over from an earlier run.
